decisions.reason: As an established supplement range that fits the firm's consumer-health expansion and pharmacy presence, it is likely to remain in the portfolio unless sales disappoint materially.
The skin and hair supplement is close to the firm's established OTC and dietary business and should be retained as part of a broader consumer-health offering.
The joint-health supplement still fits the portfolio broadening strategy, though its lower visibility and narrower positioning make it somewhat more exposed to range optimization.

The OTC migraine triptan is more strategically demanding than the supplement lines, but as a differentiated pharmacy product it is still worth keeping while the firm expands its prescription and consumer-health portfolio.
